messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "squeeze liquid directly into mouth, onto spoon, or into glass of water to drink right away"
set: ["squeeze liquid directly into mouth, onto spoon, or into glass of water to drink right away", "drink all of the mixture right away", "with a full glass of water", "take with a full glass of water", "add a little more water to the same glass, swirl gently and drink right away", "drink it straight away", "never crush or break a tramadol tablet to inhale the powder or mix it into a liquid to inject the drug into your vein", "inject into the abdomen or thigh", "one or two months into treatment", "given into abdomen only", "may be injected into thigh or abdomen or have another person inject into back of upper arm", "take the tablets with a full glass of water", "swallow the regular tablet whole with a glass of water", "do not inject into muscle or vein", "press it firmly into place", "sprinkle the medicine into a spoonful of applesauce"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
